headline: Uruguay Goods Trade Deficit Narrows to $35.3 Million on Slumping Oil Imports
summary: Uruguay's goods trade deficit contracted to $35.3 million in September as export sales climbed 7.8% while oil import expenditures dropped by over 50%.
why: Trade balance improvements support foreign reserve accumulation and provide currency stability for Latin America's high-grade sovereign borrowers.

impacts.name: Uruguayan peso
impacts.why: A narrowing trade deficit reduces net foreign exchange outflows from goods trade.
